$comment: Host adapter registry — the single source of host integration truth (plan 2026-11-04 Batch 2, VE schema pruned; Batch 8 adds the opencode instructions face via the instructions-links layer). Layers: rules-links / skills-index / memory-aggregate / instructions-links / mcp-links + 5 lints (header-lint fifth, close-out plan W3, report-mode until the W4-exit strict flip). Generated host layers are per-machine (ADJ-2d ruling A): gitignored, rebuilt by `agents sync`.
rules_exclude_reason: zh/ is the pre-2026-09-21 Chinese mirror of common/ (legacy, no-back-translation policy keeps it on disk but host activation layers must not double-load it — MS D199 precedent)

rule_descriptions.common-constraints: Hard development constraints: lockfile discipline, forbidden operations, hook status. Use when committing dependency changes or touching git workflow.
rule_descriptions.common-security: Security guidelines for JWT/OAuth/RBAC surfaces: mandatory checks before auth-adjacent edits. Use when editing auth, secrets, or permission code.
